'''Resolute Base''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] base located on the humid [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jagomir]]. The base was established in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] after the Alliance forces were driven from their [[Arda Base|base]] on [[Arda I]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces.

==Description==
===Layout===
Resolute Base consisted of ten modified pre-fab buildings, many of which were obtained during a raid on the Empire's [[74th Imperial Garrison]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The base was constructed quickly over a matter of several days. The base consisted of four barracks, two medical facilities, two command structures, a mess hall and repair bay.<ref name="OAA1" />

===Personnel===
[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Danel Qurno]], a male [[Duros/Legends|Duros]], was in command of Resolute Base with a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] named [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Yalor (Sullustan)|Yalor]] as second in command. The medical bays were run by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Lorren Morrick]] and several assistants, while the repair bay was run by a male [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] tech named [[Clik]].<ref name="OAA1" />
